research_brief.engineering_object: 公开滚动轴承振动数据及其测量链
research_brief.target_problem: 判断公开滚动轴承振动数据是否具备可追溯的测量单位、传感器/采集信息、校准线索、重复性/再现性证据和 measurement uncertainty / UQ 准备度
research_brief.target_metric: measurement traceability, repeatability, reproducibility, and uncertainty-readiness of public rolling-bearing vibration data
available_data: public raw or semi-raw rolling-bearing vibration records
official dataset metadata and open article records
resources: no equipment control and no dataset download
research_brief.time_budget: Two bounded literature rounds on 2026-08-06; no route execution
excluded_routes: services, uploads, deployment, or equipment control
hard_constraints: Use a new independent F04 search lineage
Never infer DOI, title, author list, venue, or publication status
Keep metadata-, abstract-, and full-text-level reasoning separate
Require explicit units, calibration provenance, repeatability, reproducibility, and UQ prerequisites where claimed
Stop before route generation and user confirmation
soft_preferences: open records with reproducible file descriptions
open_questions: Which public records expose enough acquisition metadata to reconstruct units, sensor provenance, and operating conditions?
Which calibration, repeatability, and reproducibility evidence is available for interpreting public bearing-vibration measurements?
Which uncertainty-aware or cross-dataset evaluations can expose measurement and domain-shift limits before a direction is confirmed?
evidence_needs: round-one role coverage of 3 direct-problem, 2 method, 2 transfer-bridge, and 1 counter/limitation
round-two evidence focused on calibration, R&R, units, and UQ prerequisites
numeric bounded criteria only when supported by the verified lineage

language_boundary: English-language journal, proceedings, and official repository records returned by the public sources
source_boundary: SciSpace and ordinary web search for discovery only

queries.query_text: public rolling bearing vibration datasets measurement metadata calibration sampling rate units
open rolling-element bearing vibration data operating condition load speed sensor acquisition
public bearing fault dataset accelerometer units calibration provenance repeatability
rolling bearing vibration calibration measurement uncertainty traceability accelerometer
rolling bearing vibration repeatability reproducibility Gage R&R measurement system
public rotating machinery bearing dataset cross-condition domain shift sensor metadata
uncertainty-aware domain generalization rolling bearing unseen operating conditions
limitations variability repeatability reproducibility public bearing vibration measurement

limitations: Dedicated academic-search MCP endpoints were unavailable; the skill's no-MCP/public-web fallback was used.
SciSpace and web search were discovery sources only.
Crossref/DataCite records were current checks; publisher pages were cross-checked where accessible and otherwise marked unavailable in provenance.
No public dataset files or model weights were downloaded.

verified_record.title: The Politecnico di Torino rolling bearing test rig: Description and analysis of open access data
verified_record.supports: Open PoliTO bearing-rig data expose speed/load/damage regimes and an endurance acquisition.
verified_record.does_not_support: It does not by itself establish cross-laboratory calibration uncertainty or reproducibility.

verified_record.title: University of Ottawa constant load and speed rolling-element bearing vibration and acoustic fault signature datasets
verified_record.supports: Open raw/processed data link accelerometer, load, speed, and temperature measurements with stated sampling and units.
verified_record.does_not_support: The constant-load/speed design does not establish cross-laboratory reproducibility.

verified_record.title: Vibration, acoustic, temperature, and motor current dataset of rotating machine under varying operating conditions for fault diagnosis
verified_record.supports: Public multi-sensor data expose bearing fault conditions, load variation, channel units, and sampling rates.
verified_record.does_not_support: The public record does not close calibration uncertainty for every channel.

verified_record.title: HUST bearing: a practical dataset for ball bearing fault diagnosis
verified_record.supports: Public raw vibration signals span bearing types, defect combinations, loads, duration, and sampling rate.
verified_record.does_not_support: Dataset construction alone does not prove sensor calibration or repeated mounting stability.

verified_record.title: MOIRA-UNIMORE Bearing Data Set for Independent Cart Systems
verified_record.supports: Public bearing data for independent cart systems provide a non-identical target context for cross-platform checks.
verified_record.does_not_support: Transfer to another rig remains a hypothesis until a decisive cross-platform measurement test.

verified_record.title: Wind turbine condition monitoring dataset of Fraunhofer LBF
verified_record.supports: A public real-world monitoring dataset combines accelerometers, tachometer, temperature, and environmental variables around bearing damage scenarios.
verified_record.does_not_support: Wind-turbine structure and environmental variation are not equivalent to a laboratory bearing rig.

verified_record.title: Rotating Electromechanical System Dataset for Condition Monitoring
verified_record.supports: An open rotating-system dataset records synchronized vibration, current, temperature, and speed under repeated operating scenarios including bearing degradation.
verified_record.does_not_support: The broader electromechanical target does not isolate bearing-specific traceability by itself.

verified_record.title: Paderborn Bearing Dataset
verified_record.supports: A current official repository record establishes a public Paderborn Bearing Dataset identifier and dataset work type.
verified_record.does_not_support: The record retrieved here did not expose a complete measurement description; use only for availability and provenance.

verified_record.title: The Politecnico di Torino rolling bearing test rig: description of the open-access data for vibration monitoring and diagnostics
verified_record.supports: The official record documents accelerometers, speed/load combinations, damage severities, temperature, and endurance acquisition.
verified_record.does_not_support: The large repository was not downloaded and does not establish inter-laboratory repeatability.

verified_record.title: Condition Monitoring of Drive Trains by Data Fusion of Acoustic Emission and Vibration Sensors Measurements of Vibrations and Acoustic Emissions on a Rotating Shaft
verified_record.supports: The official record names ICP accelerometers, sensitivity, DAQ context, and synchronized vibration/acoustic measurements.
verified_record.does_not_support: Drive-train sensor data are a bridge for provenance, not direct evidence of bearing UQ on the target rig.

verified_record.title: Measurement Uncertainty in Vibration Calibration in Frequency Range of 5 Hz to 10 kHz
verified_record.supports: The calibration study reports traceability and expanded uncertainty across 5 Hz–10 kHz with comparison to primary standards.
verified_record.does_not_support: A calibration-laboratory uncertainty budget is not a direct public bearing-dataset validation.

verified_record.title: Evaluation of the Variability of Vibration Measurement Results in Rolling Bearing Quality Control
verified_record.supports: The study separates repeatability, refit reproducibility, sensor position, frequency bands, and Gage R&R limits for rolling-bearing vibration quality control.
verified_record.does_not_support: Its numeric limits are study-specific and are not universal acceptance thresholds.

verified_record.title: Application of a Gage R&R study in evaluation of rolling bearing measurement system accuracy
verified_record.supports: The Gage R&R study makes low repeatability/reproducibility and lack of reference bearings an explicit measurement-system limitation.
verified_record.does_not_support: It does not quantify uncertainty for any one public dataset or justify universal limits.

verified_record.title: Standard Uncertainty of Rolling Bearing Vibration as Time Series
verified_record.supports: The paper applies standard uncertainty to rolling-bearing vibration time series and relates uncertainty variation to failure diameter.
verified_record.does_not_support: Its narrower venue and scope do not establish a general public-data calibration protocol.

verified_record.title: Evaluation of Dynamic Uncertainty of Rolling Bearing Vibration Performance
verified_record.supports: The study estimates time-varying intervals for rolling-bearing vibration performance and checks interval coverage against a confidence level.
verified_record.does_not_support: Model-based uncertainty is not a substitute for sensor calibration or repeatability evidence.

verified_record.title: Repeatability and reproducibility of characteristic features measured by laser Doppler vibrometry for on-line diagnostics
verified_record.venue: SPIE Proceedings Eighth International Conference on Vibration Measurements by Laser Techniques: Advances and Applications
verified_record.supports: The proceedings paper evaluates feature repeatability/reproducibility and propagates uncertainty across sensor, DAQ, and processing stages.
verified_record.does_not_support: The application is laser Doppler vibrometry and washing-machine diagnostics rather than rolling-bearing accelerometry.

verified_record.title: Cross-Domain Fault Diagnosis of Rolling Element Bearings Using Deep Generative Neural Networks
verified_record.supports: Cross-domain bearing diagnosis establishes operating-condition distribution shift as a practical validation boundary.
verified_record.does_not_support: Source-domain diagnostic performance does not prove measurement traceability or target-domain transfer.

verified_record.title: Uncertainty-Weighted Domain Generalization for Remaining Useful Life Prediction of Rolling Bearings Under Unseen Conditions
verified_record.supports: Uncertainty-weighted domain generalization is a method bridge for unseen bearing conditions and explicit predictive uncertainty.
verified_record.does_not_support: Model uncertainty does not close physical measurement UQ prerequisites.

round_one_dispositions.reason: Retained as foundational direct evidence but not selected in the tighter R&R/UQ-focused second-round view.
The second-round direct-data slot prioritizes a newer multi-bearing raw-signal record after the measurement-metadata filter.
The second-round direct-data slot adds an independent-cart-system context for cross-platform comparison.
The second-round method set adds a bearing-specific standard-uncertainty record alongside the calibration traceability paper.
The second-round method set adds dynamic interval and coverage evidence while retaining the R&R limitation as a counter.
The second-round transfer slot shifts from a heterogeneous turbine dataset to an uncertainty-weighted unseen-condition method bridge.
Cross-domain shift remains a limitation context, but the compact second-round view keeps the direct R&R counter and UQ transfer bridge.
The counter/limitation evidence directly tests whether public vibration measurements can be treated as repeatable and reproducible.

search_limitations: Round two is bounded, not exhaustive.
Physical calibration certificates and raw repeat-run files were not downloaded.
Model uncertainty and physical measurement uncertainty remain separate evidence classes.
